title: Print Hello, World!
instruction: Write a `print()` statement that outputs **Hello, World!** exactly as shown.

title: Print your name
instruction: Write a `print()` statement that outputs **your name** to the screen. You can use any name you like — just make sure the output isn't empty!

title: Print with single quotes
instruction: Use **single quotes** to print the greeting **Greetings, Earthling!** to the screen.  Remember: single quotes look like `'this'`, not `"this"`.
starter_code: # Use single quotes for the string

title: Print two separate lines
instruction: Use **two separate `print()` statements** to output your **first name** on the first line and your **last name** on the second line.  Each `print()` call creates its own line of output.

title: Print your favorite color
instruction: Print your **favorite color** from this list: **Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Orange, Pink, Black**.  Pick exactly one color and print it as a string.  Use either double or single quotes — your choice.
